hero.filename: Atlantic City— America’s All-Year Resort, Pennsylvania Railroad, painting by Edward Mason Eggleston.jpg
hero.caption: Poster for Pennsylvania Railroad.  Atlantic City— America’s All-Year Resort. Painting by Edward Mason Eggleston. Published by the Osborne Company (O Co) of Clifton, New Jersey, shown at bottom right of image. Image includes the Marlborough-Blenheim Hotel over her left shoulder (right side of image).

images.filename: Marlborough-Blenheim Hotel, Atlantic City, New Jersey.png
images.caption: Photochrome postcard of the elegant Marlborough-Blenheim Hotel, Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, built in 1913. Published by The Post Card Distributing Co., Atlantic City, New Jersey. The back is divided and bears a cancelled one-cent stamp of George Washington.
